description: This file contains unit tests for the SAML2 authentication component within the SuiteCRM project, specifically testing the behavior of the SAML2Authenticate class and associated functions.

classes.name: SAML2AuthenticateTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing SAML2 authentication features in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testEntryPointNoAuth
methods.description: Tests that checkEntryPointRequiresAuth correctly returns false when no authentication is required.

methods.name: testIncompleteSettings
methods.description: Verifies that getSAML2Metadata throws an exception when provided incomplete settings.

methods.name: testMinimalValidExample
methods.description: Checks that getSAML2Metadata produces valid metadata XML given a minimal set of valid settings.
